title: 聽
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved final source for L179 聽. Latest origin/main at production start is complete through L174 跑, so L179 depends on not-yet-merged L175 馬, L176 停, L177 叫, and L178 聲 before production JSON may merge. Provisional learned chars from the handoff are 馬, 停, 叫, 聲. Do not merge production JSON, planner-data, or ledger until L175-L178 are present in latest origin/main. Use Taiwan Traditional Chinese and Taiwan zhuyin only. Use 這裡, not 這裏, because 裡 is the learned character. Do not introduce display text characters such as 音、見、受、傷、館、安、靜 unless they are already learned by latest origin/main. Images must be square 1:1 compositions using L058 style anchors, with no text, numbers, signs, letters, zhuyin, labels, logos, or watermarks. S01 and S02 must have visual continuity: same road-side / grass-edge setting and same fixed 我 girl; S02 should feel like it follows S01. Audio must be standalone OpenAI charAudio, whole-sentence AI audio, independent G02 prefix/suffix from exact fragments, and independent G05 wrong-choice whole-sentence audio.
